verdict.rationale: Asana documents a dedicated deprecation process. It promises a clear description of each change, its impact on requests and a migration plan, plus a deprecation period during which callers can choose old or new behavior. The API signals upcoming changes through Asana-Change response headers, and callers can opt in or out per request with Asana-Enable and Asana-Disable headers. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a numbered or URL-based API version scheme (versioning here is feature-flag based, plus versioned SDKs), stated deprecation timeframes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy works in practice.
